typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Action as string,
		Status as string,
		{Start Date} as string,
		{End Date} as string,
		{Path (Key Field)} as string,
		{Event ID (Key Field)} as string,
		{Lead Source Weight} as string,
		{Prospect Type} as string,
		BUSINESS_LINE as string,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME as string,
		Market as string,
		Territory as string,
		{Media Type} as string,
		Segment as string,
		Program as string,
		Campaign as string,
		{Lead Source Type} as string,
		{Lead Source Name} as string,
		MEDIA_CODE as string,
		MEDIA_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CREATIVE_CODE as string,
		CREATIVE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		{800#} as string,
		DNIS as string,
		{Call Routing Code} as string,
		{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)} as string,
		{Agent #} as string,
		{LG Suffix} as string,
		{Referral ID Req (Y/N)} as string,
		{Referral ID Tool Tip (mouse over)} as string,
		Offer as string,
		{Client Internal Job#} as string,
		{Ad Agency Job#} as string,
		{Ad Agency ID} as string,
		{URL (Media Path)} as string,
		{CID Code (Application Code)} as string,
		{CID Referring URL} as string,
		EXTRACT_DATE as string,
		Attribute as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_campaignupdate*']) ~> Inbound
DerivedColumn select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		IsActive = DerivedColumn@Status,
		StartDate = {Start Date},
		EndDate = {End Date},
		Media_Path_Name__c = {Path (Key Field)},
		Promo_Id__c = {Event ID (Key Field)},
		Lead_Source_Weight__c = {Lead Source Weight},
		Prospect_Type__c = {Prospect Type},
		LOB__c = BUSINESS_LINE,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME__c = BUSINESS_LINE_NAME,
		Media_Market__c = Market,
		Media_Territory_Name__c = Territory,
		Type = {Media Type},
		Media_Segment_Name__c = Segment,
		Program__c = Program,
		Name = Campaign,
		Lead_Source_Type__c = {Lead Source Type},
		LeadSourceName__c = {Lead Source Name},
		Media_Code__c = MEDIA_CODE,
		Media_Description__c = MEDIA_DESCRIPTION,
		Creative_Code__c = CREATIVE_CODE,
		Creative_Description__c = CREATIVE_DESCRIPTION,
		ednc_toll_free_num__c = {800#},
		DNIS__c = DNIS,
		Call_Routing_Info__c = {Call Routing Code},
		Use_CM_Agent__c = {Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)},
		Agent_Number__c = {Agent #},
		LG_Suffix__c = {LG Suffix},
		Referral_ID_Req__c = {Referral ID Req (Y/N)},
		Referral_ID_Tool_Tip__c = {Referral ID Tool Tip (mouse over)},
		Offer__c = Offer,
		Client_Internal_Job__c = {Client Internal Job#},
		Ad_Agency_Job__c = {Ad Agency Job#},
		cls_ad_id__c = {Ad Agency ID},
		Path__c = {URL (Media Path)},
		CID_Code__c = {CID Code (Application Code)},
		CID_Referring_URL__c = {CID Referring URL},
		Extract_Date__c = EXTRACT_DATE,
		Attribute__c = Attribute,
		ACTION = Action
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select
Select filter(upper(ACTION) == 'U') ~> filterU
Select filter(upper(ACTION) == 'N') ~> filterN
ConditionalSplit1@cleanDATA derive(StartDate = toTimestamp({Start Date}),
		END_DATE = toTimestamp({End Date}),
		STATUS = toBoolean(iif(upper(Status)=='A','true',iif(upper(Status)=='I','false',''))),
		EXTRACT_DATE = toTimestamp(EXTRACT_DATE),
		REFERRAL_ID = toBoolean({Referral ID Req (Y/N)}),
		Status = toBoolean(iif(upper(Status)=='A','true',iif(upper(Status)=='I','false',''))),
		{Referral ID Req (Y/N)} = toBoolean(iif(isNull({Referral ID Req (Y/N)}),'false',{Referral ID Req (Y/N)})),
		{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)} = toBoolean(iif(isNull({Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)}),'false',{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)}))) ~> DerivedColumn
AddADFId split(isNull(Status)||isNull({Start Date})||isNull({Path (Key Field)})||isNull({Event ID (Key Field)})||isNull({Lead Source Weight})||isNull({Lead Source Name})||(isNull({800#}) && (upper({Path (Key Field)}) == 'INBOUND'||upper({Path (Key Field)}) == 'IB'))||(isNull(DNIS) && (upper({Path (Key Field)}) == 'INBOUND'||upper({Path (Key Field)}) == 'IB'))||isNull(Action)||not(in(['U', 'u', 'N', 'n'], Action)),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectNULL, cleanDATA)
ConditionalSplit1@rejectNULL derive(REJECT_REASON = concat(iif(isNull(Status)||isNull({Start Date})||isNull({Path (Key Field)})||isNull({Event ID (Key Field)})||isNull({Lead Source Weight})||isNull({Lead Source Name})||isNull({800#})||isNull(DNIS)||isNull(Action), concat('ADF:Field contains NULL value: ', iif(isNull(Action), 'Action, ', ''), iif(isNull(Status), 'Status, ', ''), iif(isNull({Start Date}), '{Start Date}, ', ''), iif(isNull({Path (Key Field)}), '{Path (Key Field)}, ', ''), iif(isNull({Event ID (Key Field)}), '{Event ID (Key Field)}, ', ''), iif(isNull({Lead Source Weight}), '{Lead Source Weight}, ', ''), iif(isNull({Lead Source Name}), '{Lead Source Name}, ', ''), iif(isNull({800#}), '{800#}, ', ''), iif(isNull(DNIS), 'DNIS', ''), '.'), ''), iif(not(in(['U', 'u', 'N', 'n'], Action)), concat('ADF:Action column contain invalid value: ', Action, '.'), ''))) ~> errorLog
Inbound derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
errorLog select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
filterN select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		IsActive,
		StartDate,
		EndDate,
		Media_Path_Name__c,
		Promo_Id__c,
		Lead_Source_Weight__c,
		Prospect_Type__c,
		LOB__c,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME__c,
		Media_Market__c,
		Media_Territory_Name__c,
		Type,
		Media_Segment_Name__c,
		Program__c,
		Name,
		Lead_Source_Type__c,
		LeadSourceName__c,
		Media_Code__c,
		Media_Description__c,
		Creative_Code__c,
		Creative_Description__c,
		ednc_toll_free_num__c,
		DNIS__c,
		Call_Routing_Info__c,
		Use_CM_Agent__c,
		Agent_Number__c,
		LG_Suffix__c,
		Referral_ID_Req__c,
		Referral_ID_Tool_Tip__c,
		Offer__c,
		Client_Internal_Job__c,
		Ad_Agency_Job__c,
		cls_ad_id__c,
		Path__c,
		CID_Code__c,
		CID_Referring_URL__c,
		Extract_Date__c,
		Attribute__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
filterU select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		IsActive,
		StartDate,
		EndDate,
		Media_Path_Name__c,
		Promo_Id__c,
		Lead_Source_Weight__c,
		Prospect_Type__c,
		LOB__c,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME__c,
		Media_Market__c,
		Media_Territory_Name__c,
		Type,
		Media_Segment_Name__c,
		Program__c,
		Name,
		Lead_Source_Type__c,
		LeadSourceName__c,
		Media_Code__c,
		Media_Description__c,
		Creative_Code__c,
		Creative_Description__c,
		ednc_toll_free_num__c,
		DNIS__c,
		Call_Routing_Info__c,
		Use_CM_Agent__c,
		Agent_Number__c,
		LG_Suffix__c,
		Referral_ID_Req__c,
		Referral_ID_Tool_Tip__c,
		Offer__c,
		Client_Internal_Job__c,
		Ad_Agency_Job__c,
		cls_ad_id__c,
		Path__c,
		CID_Code__c,
		CID_Referring_URL__c,
		Extract_Date__c,
		Attribute__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select3
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_campaignupdate_Campaign.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		IsActive,
		StartDate,
		EndDate,
		Media_Path_Name__c,
		Promo_Id__c,
		Lead_Source_Weight__c,
		Prospect_Type__c,
		LOB__c,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME__c,
		Media_Market__c,
		Media_Territory_Name__c,
		Type,
		Media_Segment_Name__c,
		Program__c,
		Name,
		Lead_Source_Type__c,
		LeadSourceName__c,
		Media_Code__c,
		Media_Description__c,
		Creative_Code__c,
		Creative_Description__c,
		ednc_toll_free_num__c,
		DNIS__c,
		Call_Routing_Info__c,
		Use_CM_Agent__c,
		Agent_Number__c,
		LG_Suffix__c,
		Referral_ID_Req__c,
		Referral_ID_Tool_Tip__c,
		Offer__c,
		Client_Internal_Job__c,
		Ad_Agency_Job__c,
		Ad_Agency_ID__c = cls_ad_id__c,
		Path__c,
		CID_Code__c,
		CID_Referring_URL__c,
		Extract_Date__c,
		Attribute__c
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertN

	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_campaignupdate_Campaign.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(

		EndDate,
		Media_Path_Name__c,

		Type,

		Program__c,
		Name,

		LeadSourceName__c,
		Media_Code__c,
		Media_Description__c,
		Creative_Code__c,
		Creative_Description__c,

		DNIS__c,
		Call_Routing_Info__c,
		Use_CM_Agent__c,
		Agent_Number__c,
		LG_Suffix__c,
		Referral_ID_Req__c,
		Referral_ID_Tool_Tip__c,
		Offer__c,
		Client_Internal_Job__c,

		Ad_Agency_ID__c = cls_ad_id__c,
		Path__c,

	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertU
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_campaignupdate_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Reject

	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_campaignupdate_raw.csv')],
